limits: Independent source branches and historical packets, not a merged six-workload binary.
No new H100 run, reproduction or GPU validation is implied by publication.
Frozen packets keep absolute paths, asset hashes, source checks and historical failed/cancelled variants.
Models, trainable checkpoints, input traces, environment archives, 18GiB Grid table and raw profiles stay remote.
Paths/asset binding need explicit new-source admission on another host; no automatic restart.
W4 is H100 Resident experiment, not A100 C51; W5 approximate Grid is never W6 continuous AR.
Numerical NOT_RUN/REVIEW and FA3 FAIL remain; component evidence is not full trajectory proof.
